description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the searchbyimage operation for online calls to the Taobao Alliance edition
description_zh: 本文为您介绍searchbyimage接口的语法及示例，用于向淘宝联盟版在线调用
kebab_example: aliyun imagesearch search-image --category-id 88888888 --instance-name phimagesearch --product-id pro-goods-25376 --pic-name goods-23312-1 --pic-content iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAV8AAADwAQMAAACdRvVNAAAABGdBTUEAALGPC/xhBQAAAAFzUkdCAK7OHOkAAAADUExURQAAAKd6PdoAAAABdFJOUyR85Ty3AAAAIUlEQVRo3u3BAQ0AAADCoPdPbQ8HFAAAAAAAAAAAAADPBiowAAGR02EbAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC --crop true --biz-region 32,282,43,256 --num 10 --start 0 --type SearchByPic --filter int_attr_=_100000000_AND_int_attr_200000000_AND_int_attr=100000252_AND_str_attr=_87 --api-version 2019-03-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchImage

parameters.help_en:
The product category. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179184.html.
 - For product image search, if you specify a category, the specified category is used. If you do not specify a category, the system predicts the category. You can obtain the predicted category from the response.
<props="china">
 - For fabric, trademark, general furniture and home, and industrial hardware searches, the system sets the category to 88888888 regardless of whether you specify a category.
</props>
<props="intl">
 - For generic image search, the system sets the category to 88888888 regardless of whether you specify a category.
</props>
parameters.help_zh:
商品类目。具体请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179184.html。
 - 对于商品搜索，如果设置类目，则以设置的为准；如果不设置类目，则由系统进行类目预测，预测的类目结果可以在Response中获取 。
<props="china">
 - 对于布料、商标、通用家具家居和工业五金搜索，不论是否设置类目，系统会将类目设置为88888888。
</props>
<props="intl">
 - 对于通用搜索，不论是否设置类目，系统会将类目设置为88888888。
</props>
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Image Search instance. The name can be up to 20 characters in length.
If you have purchased an Image Search instance, log on to the [Image Search console](https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com/) to view the instance name.
If you have not purchased an Image Search instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179178.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66569.html.
>The instance name is not the instance ID. Make sure that you distinguish between them
parameters.help_zh:
图搜实例名称。最多支持20个字符。
如果已经购买图搜实例可登录[图像搜索管控台](https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com/)查看。
如果没有购买图搜实例可参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179178.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66569.html。
>这里的实例名称并非实例ID，使用时请区分
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The product ID. The ID can be up to 512 characters in length.

>A product can have multiple images
parameters.help_zh:
商品ID，最多支持512个字符。

>一个商品可以有多张图片
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en:
The image name. The name can be up to 512 characters in length.
> - The combination of ProductId and PicName uniquely identifies an image.
- If you add multiple images with the same ProductId and PicName, the last added image overwrites the previous ones
parameters.help_zh:
图片名称，最多支持512个字符。
> - ProductId和PicName唯一确定一张图片。
- 如果多次添加图片具有相同的ProductId和PicName，以最后一次添加为准，前面添加的图片将被覆盖
parameters.name: pic_name

parameters.help_en:
The image content, which is Base64-encoded.

 - The image size cannot exceed 4 MB.
 - Image formats: PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, WEBP, TIFF, and PPM.
 - The transmission wait time cannot exceed 5 seconds.
<props="china">
 - For product image search and generic image search, the image width and height must be at least 100 pixels and at most 4,096 pixels.
 - For trademark image search, the image width and height must be at least 200 pixels and less than 4,096 pixels.
 - For fabric image search, the image width and height must be at least 448 pixels and at most 4,096 pixels.
</props>
<props="intl">
 - For product image search and generic image search, the image width and height must be at least 100 pixels and at most 4,096 pixels.
</props>
 - The image must not contain rotation information
parameters.help_zh:
图片内容，Base64编码。

 - 图片大小要求不超过4 MB。
 - 图片格式：PNG、JPG、JPEG、BMP、GIF、WEBP、TIFF、PPM。
 - 传输等待时间不超过5秒。
<props="china">
 - 服务类型为商品图片搜索和通用图片搜索时，图片长和宽像素要求大于等于100且小于等于4096。
 - 服务类型为商标图片搜索时，图片长和宽像素要求大于等于200且小于4096。
 - 服务类型为布料图片搜索时，图片长和宽像素要求大于等于448且小于等于4096。
</props>
<props="intl">
 - 服务类型为商品图片搜索和通用图片搜索时，图片长和宽像素要求大于等于100且小于等于4096。
</props>
 - 图片中不能包含旋转信息
parameters.name: pic_content

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform subject identification. Default value: true.
 - If this parameter is set to true, the system performs subject identification and searches based on the identified subject. You can obtain the subject identification result from the response.
 - If this parameter is set to false, the system does not perform subject identification and searches based on the entire image.
<props="china">
- For fabric image search, this parameter is ignored and the system searches based on the entire image.
</props>
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要进行主体识别。默认true。
 - 为true时，由系统进行主体识别，以识别的主体进行搜索，主体识别结果可在Response中获取。
 - 为false时，则不进行主体识别，以整张图进行搜索。
<props="china">
- 对于布料图片搜索，此参数会被忽略，系统会以整张图进行搜索。
</props>
parameters.name: crop

parameters.help_en:
The subject region of the image. Format: `x1,x2,y1,y2`, where `x1,y1` is the upper-left point and `x2,y2` is the lower-right point.
<props="china">
> - If you specify Region, the system searches based on the specified region regardless of the value of the Crop parameter.
- For fabric image search, this parameter is ignored and the system searches based on the entire image.
</props>

<props="intl">
> For fabric image search, this parameter is ignored and the system searches based on the entire image.
</props>
parameters.help_zh:
图片的主体区域，格式为`x1,x2,y1,y2,` 其中`x1,y1` 是左上角的点，`x2,y2`是右下角的点。
<props="china">
> - 若用户设置了Region，则不论Crop参数为何值，都将以用户输入Region进行搜索。
- 对于布料图片搜索，此参数会被忽略，系统会以整张图进行搜索。
</props>

<props="intl">
> 对于布料图片搜索，此参数会被忽略，系统会以整张图进行搜索。
</props>
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The number of results to return. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果的数目。取值范围：1~100。默认值为10
parameters.name: num

parameters.help_en: The start position of the results to return. Valid values: 0 to 499. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果的起始位置。取值范围：0~499。默认值为0
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en:
The search type. Valid values:
- SearchByPic (default): searches for similar images by image.
- SearchByName: searches for similar images by the name of an image that has been added
parameters.help_zh:
搜索类型。包括：
- SearchByPic（默认）：根据图片搜索相似图片。
- SearchByName：根据已添加的图片搜索相似图片
parameters.name: type

parameters.example: (int_attr >= 100000000 AND int_attr < 200000000 AND int_attr=100000252 AND str_attr=\"87\")
parameters.help_en:
The filter condition. The int_attr field supports the following operators: greater than (>), greater than or equal to (>=), less than (<), less than or equal to (<=), and equal to (=). The str_attr field supports the equal to (=) and not equal to (!=) operators. Multiple conditions can be connected by using AND or OR.
Examples:
- int_attr >= 100.
- str_attr != "value1".
- int_attr = 1000 AND str_attr = "value1"
parameters.help_zh:
过滤条件。int_attr支持的操作符有大于号(>)、大于等于号(>=)、小于号(<)、小于等于号(<=)、等于号(=)。str_attr支持的操作符有等于号(=)和不等号(!=)，多个条件之支持AND和OR进行连接。
例如：
- int_attr >= 100。
- str_attr != "value1"。
- int_attr = 1000 AND str_attr = "value1"
parameters.name: filter
